newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde April 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde April 15.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Junior doctors announce end of their five-week strike.
-- President Jacques Chirac and Prime Minister Alain Juppe are said to hesitate between a government reshuffle and an early legislative election.
-- Insurer CNP registered a 1.57 billion franc profit for 1996, ahead of a possible privatisation.
-- Unions at TAT and Air Liberte enter seventh day of strike to protest terms of their planned merger.
-- Leclerc supermarkets co-chairman Michel-Edouard Leclerc says in an interview consumers responded favourably to campaign introducing the euro in supermarkets.
